snippet.title: Browser MMORPG, Mirage Online Classic, Major Battle Against Snowdrift in Ridorana!
snippet.description:
https://www.MirageOnlineClassic.com

As a spiritual successor to 2001's Mirage Online, this free-to-play web-based top-down 2D indie massive multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) is playable from both a desktop or mobile web browser or downloadable from steam.

No microtransactions, Patreon-supported, browser-based, proven & active developers, skill-based 2D action combat with a community that has helped adapt late-90s MMO gameplay with modern advancements.
